entries.zh: 多子之父；家道兴旺（多子多孙）
entries.en: father of many children; a man whose family line flourishes with offspring
entries.notes: H 栏“兴”取“兴旺、多子”义，M 栏附“acncuntar”疑为旁注残文，义据西语定。

entries.en: to adopt; to take in and raise (a child)
entries.notes: source_L 缩写作“p. y m. criância”（父母之养育/收养），“s. 8.”疑指参见第 8 条“养父”。

entries.zh: 引爹；养父（收养子女的父亲）
entries.notes: 同上条，source_L 为缩写“p. y m. criância”，“引爹”即收养之父。

entries.zh: 太老（对官员之父的尊称）；老太爷
entries.en: father of a mandarin; an official's father (respectful "old gentleman")
entries.notes: source_M 第三音节“lô”与“太老”不合，疑为衍文或“太老爷”残写。
source_L 残作“p̃. y m̃. yparience”（父母及亲戚），与“手足”仅部分相合。

entries.en: to register one's name; to enter on a roll (padrón)
entries.notes: source_L 后半“compadro nar~”残缺，义据“Padrón（名册、登记）”定。
H 栏有[疑:選仕/還伊]，M“hūan ī”对应“還伊”，末音“gong”疑为另注。

entries.en: to pay with one's life; to atone by one's life
entries.notes: H 栏“僧”当为“償”之讹，M 中“chiāng mià”即“償命”；“sān xīn”一段残损难解。

entries.en: to repay a benefit; to requite (a favor)
entries.notes: H 栏“伴”与西语“pagar el beneficio”不合，M“pōã hūan pōã”难解，语义存疑。

entries.zh: 赔偿；偿付（税款、债务或担保）
entries.en: to pay; to compensate; to pay duties or on a surety
entries.notes: source_L 缩写“Dtos”疑为“derechos”（税项）之省，故留备一说。

entries.zh: 零星偿还；分期还清（赊账陆续偿付）
entries.en: to pay little by little; to pay in installments
entries.notes: H 栏有[疑:賸/賖還]，M“sē hūan”近“賖還”，取零星偿还义。

entries.en: to pay with one's life; to repay with one's life
entries.notes: H 栏有[疑:選/還]，M“hūan”对应“還”，取以命偿还义。
